relations.gap: L1.hole.change-effective-time. The no-answer-on-withdrawal behavior the unique-answer invariants now state is fully expressed, but unexercised: this job produces no statement with is_withdrawal true today, because the sources that could carry a withdrawal signal (raw.customer_cdc.cdc_flag, raw.account_cdc.cdc_flag) supply no effective-time handoff of their own and stay deferred under the same hole.

L1.hole.change-effective-time. The none-once-withdrawn behavior is fully expressed by is_current's derivation rule and the single-current invariants, but unexercised: every statement this job currently produces has is_withdrawal false, because the only sources that could set it true (raw.customer_cdc.cdc_flag, raw.account_cdc.cdc_flag) remain deferred under the same hole.

L1.hole.owner-change-reversions-account; also bounded by L1.hole.change-effective-time (the incremental account CDC file's owner handoff remains deferred pending its own effective moment). The owner-standing cascade and the reporting invariant are fully expressed but unexercised for the same reason: no customer statement this job currently produces has is_withdrawal true, so no account has yet been observed losing standing through its owner's withdrawal, or reported for one.

L1.hole.change-effective-time bounds the deferred CDC-sourced handoffs above, which cannot yet be projected, and is also why the withdrawal narrowing and inv.withdrawal_never_reaches_account_status are unexercised: no source this job reads today can produce a withdrawal statement.

raw.customer_cdc.c_st_id and raw.account_cdc.ca_st_id are also coded fields this job reads, against the same anchored status_codes vocabulary, but their handoffs remain deferred under L1.hole.change-effective-time and derive no fact yet; this invariant does not yet check them, and must be extended to cover them once those handoffs are undeferred. Listed under hole.change_effective_time.blocks even though it has no deferred member, because that hole's resolution (whether an incremental change file's own status value takes effect at all) bears on whether the deferred c_st_id/ca_st_id handoffs this gap names ever become this group's members.

L1.hole.change-effective-time, L1.hole.batch-identity, L1.hole.owner-change-reversions-account, and L1.hole.held-first-report-placement each bound part of this group coverage; see coverage_claim.

L1.hole.deletion-reversal bounds whether the withdrawn attribute, once true, could ever be reset by a later report resuming the record; until answered, it is never reset, per the withdrawn type's own parallel_assumption.
L1.hole.batch-identity bounds latest_change reliance on file production order rather than a report carrying which file delivered it.

L1.hole.deletion-reversal bounds this group's row-per-pair claim for a pair with a cdc_flag D report followed by a later non-D report: what such a report means is undecided, so that ordering is excluded from both inv.eligible_holding_report_persisted and inv.holding_change_absent_for_withdrawn_only_pair.
